step_by_step_reasoning: The visual architecture shows an IoT data ingestion, analysis, storage, and visualization pipeline. IoT devices send temperature data via MQTT to IoT Core, which triggers an IoT Rule. The rule forwards data to a Firehose delivery stream. Firehose stores raw messages directly into an S3 bucket ('RAW') and passes data into Kinesis Data Analytics. Kinesis Data Analytics processes the streaming data using SQL/Flink and sends the output to both a second Firehose stream (which saves 'PROCESSED' data to another S3 bucket) and an AWS Lambda function. Lambda updates Amazon DynamoDB with processed metrics. On the visualization side, Amazon CloudFront hosts a static web application that reads data from DynamoDB, with Amazon Cognito handling user authentication.
